name: The Westin Dragonara Resort, Malta
positioning: A seaside family resort on its own private peninsula in St. Julian's, with sea-view rooms, waterfront Luxury Bay Suites and the Dragonara casino in a 19th-century palace
best_for: Families who want a kids club and several pools
Travelers who want a sea-view base within walking distance of St. Julian's

facts.text: The resort is reached through a private gateway inscribed with Virgil's proverb, God made this gem for us.
The villa-style lobby has floor-to-ceiling windows and a sun-drenched terrace overlooking the coastline.
Luxury Bay Suites have a kitchenette, a walk-in rain shower, a free-standing bathtub and two private terraces.
Luxury Bay Suites are inspired by the hues of Maltese limestone and the turquoise of the Mediterranean.
The top-floor Presidential Penthouse Suites feature artworks by local artist Pawl Carbonaro.
The resort has a heated indoor pool and the heated outdoor Bay View Pool.
Spa treatments include aromatherapy, stone therapy, candle massage, body scrubs and wraps, and couple's massage.
Divewise Malta, a dive school for recreational and technical divers, is on the resort grounds.
The Westin Family Kids Club is for ages 3 to 12.
Quadro is the flagship restaurant, serving simple homemade dishes with fresh local produce.
Malta International Airport and Valletta are a 20-minute drive away.

highlights.text: The resort stands on a 74,000-square-meter private peninsula in St. Julian's.
The Dragonara casino is in a 19th-century palace built by the Marquis Scicluna, with a colonnaded veranda that meets the sea.
Luxury Bay Suites sit in their own private annex right on the water's edge.
Most rooms and suites have views of the St. Julian's coastline and the Mediterranean from at least one private balcony or terrace.
The grounds are landscaped around age-old artefacts, sunken gardens and pools, with ocean views throughout.

considerations.text: The Reef Club Pool is closed from November to April.
The resort sits on its own grounds but is within walking distance of the centre of St. Julian's.
WhataHotel notes it can be busy during the peak summer season.
